name: Tagalog War
source:
Experience the 1896 Philippine Revolution told in a simplistic way - but still enough to shed some light on a few areas skimmed or ignored entirely by school textbooks in the Philippines.

[From [url=https://cavsoft-co-ltd.itch.io/tagalog-war]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
以简明的方式体验1896年菲律宾革命的历史，同时了解一些被菲律宾学校教科书一笔带过，甚至完全忽略的内容。

[摘自[url=https://cavsoft-co-ltd.itch.io/tagalog-war]itch.io[/url]]
